metadata.notes: Minimal tool entity, added only so data/actions/fry.json's requiredTools reference resolves. Not fully modeled (no thermophysical data yet), same as knife.json.
metadata.noIsDeepVesselNote: Deliberately does NOT declare isDeepVessel (see pot.json/saucepan.json, action.ts's requiredToolCapabilities, added 2026-08-14) — this entity models a typical shallow frying pan, the real tool FRY/PAR_FRY need (wide surface area, shallow sides), which genuinely cannot hold enough water depth to submerge an egg for BOIL/SIMMER/PASTEURIZE. Leaving this capability unasserted (not explicitly false, per EntitySchema's own missing-vs-false distinction) is the honest choice: a specific deep sauté pan could reasonably earn this capability as its own entity later, but this generic 'pan' shouldn't silently gain it just to make a robot's tool substitution more permissive than the physical object it represents actually allows.
